<function name="IsPlayer" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Checks if the entity is a player or not.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the entity is a player.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Checks if two entities are players.</description>
	<code>
print( Entity( 1 ):IsPlayer() )
print( ents.FindByClass( "prop_physics" )[ 1 ]:IsPlayer() )
	</code>
	<output>
```
true
false
```
	</output>

</example>
